load.generator: sibuna-bench generate (open loop, one blocking thread per connection)
load.workload: admitted: GET /private with a valid session cookie

method: Each connection sends on a fixed schedule; latency counts from the due time when the previous answer made the request late, otherwise from the actual send (coordinated-omission correction as in wrk2). Percentiles are nearest-rank over every measured request of one run; each figure is the median over the repetitions, with the min-max spread beside it in latency_us.
